note: v1 clerking answers → payload v2 ("Continue in the new format"). Keyed by the v1 finding token: a symptom_catalog code (the 89 of 0042/0045, the 17 of 0076) or a CFC finding concept id. yes = complaint or ROS present; no = ROS absent; null = cannot occur (complaint-only). A token with no row is carried as text. 'Not asked' carries across as not asked.
